DeskOS · a note for Tensor Systems

Hello,

I looked at tensor.co.zw: your site talks about “tender”.

So rather than send a brochure, here is the thing itself, written for you and nobody else:

Three things worth doing this week, in the order I would do them, given what your site currently shows. Nothing here needs a purchase, an account, or a reply.

1. Name the one number you would want to move this quarter, and write it where you can see it.
2. Find the smallest change that would move it, and give it an owner and a date.
3. Write down what would tell you it worked — before you start, not after.

That is the whole freebie. If it is useful, I am glad. If you want the version built into your own site or desk, reply and say so, and I will send the price in one line — no call, no calendar.

Either way: thank you for reading this far.

Courage
Jacaranda Labs · Harare
